# AWS IoT Wireless

Store LoRaWAN resources and simulate local uplinks through the IoT MQTT broker and topic rules.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `iotwireless` |
| Signing name | `iotwireless` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2020-11-22` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local simulated uplinks through IoT MQTT and rules; durable downlink records and deterministic multicast/FUOTA worker; no radio transport |
| Selected operations | 68 of 112 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-iot-wireless) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No radio transmission, LoRaWAN network server, CUPS/LNS listener or server trust certificate, firmware transfer, real gateway health, positioning or IAM role assumption/policy evaluation; local statistics are simulation values only.
- Sidewalk wireless devices and manufacturing-serial lookup require unsupported partner account linking; Sidewalk device profiles are records with a locally generated public-key identifier and false qualification status.
- Partner accounts, network analyzer, positioning/GetPositionEstimate, import tasks, gateway task definitions/tasks/firmware, event configurations and metrics are not whitelisted.
- CloudFormation WirelessDevice and WirelessGateway are unsupported: their mutable full radio/activation/EUI properties cannot be completely expressed through the implemented update APIs. Sidewalk CloudFormation profiles and service-profile derived radio attributes absent from the API are unsupported.
- FUOTA tasks and their associations can change only before starting; started tasks cannot be restarted. Multicast group queues have no list API and remain until group deletion. Log levels are stored without log emission.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
